svg.title: Windway Jungle SVG collection — 25 original drawings
svg.desc: A labelled contact sheet showing nine jungle animals, three fictional crew portraits named WAQAR, IMRAN and TATHEER, five environment illustrations and eight jungle race icons in jade, marigold and coral.

g.text: Meet the wildlife, the crew and the new jungle race-day kit.
WAQAR, IMRAN and TATHEER are original fictional characters — no real-person likeness is assumed.
